name: FluidUse
notes: Published by FluidInference; the package targets macOS 14 or later. AccessibilityFormDriver snapshots the focused window of another running app through the macOS Accessibility API into form elements addressed by tokens, writes values through AXValue and presses buttons and checkboxes with AXPress; for Safari, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Firefox and similar browsers it sends real key events instead, because those apply AXValue writes to the focused field. WebFormDriver does the same for an embedded WKWebView through an injected script. FormSchema renders each field's context and a fixed option list (fill Label: value for each document entity, check, click, skip) for a model to score, and decodes the chosen option into an action. The README's form model is CUA-S1-FORMS, a 706K-parameter form specialist from Cua converted to Core ML; its manager (CuaS1FormsManager) comes from the FluidAudio package dependency, not from this tree. Most of the package consists of on-device Core ML runtimes for general typed-decision, classification, embedding and OCR models (laya, GLiNER 2.5, Kev, Clef, Intern-Decision, SigLIP2 and others) and demos such as Tetris and 2048 players, which do not operate GUIs. Latency and accuracy figures in the README are publisher measurements. Root LICENSE is Apache-2.0; not a fork, not archived; the latest release, v0.3.0, predates the inspected commit. Code was read, not run.
summary: Swift package for local computer use on Apple silicon that reads forms in running Mac apps or browsers through the Accessibility API and fills them with on-device Core ML decision models.
